scene: The gardener's chest pops open, beaming a glowing transit map.
picture: Flat side view. On the far left, a tiny red spiral tram sits on corkscrew rails. Left of centre, the grandmother in pink tracksuit and white dog stand beside the open-chested brass gardener. Centre, a sleek hover metro floats above a low platform. On the right, a yellow twin-engine flying scooter rests on the lawn.
shown: a winding corkscrew rail track and small red tram on the far left
a sleek floating silver carriage waiting at a raised platform in the centre
a bright yellow jet scooter resting on kickstands on the right
